message.content:
At a pressure of **10 kPa** (≈ 0.1 atm) water’s freezing (melting) point is only slightly below its normal 0 °C value.  
Using the water phase‑diagram (or the Clausius–Clapeyron relation for the solid–liquid transition), the freezing point at 10 kPa is approximately:

**≈ –2 °C**

(For reference, at this pressure water boils at roughly 50 °C.)
